subject: general
question:
L, K, J, H, G, F, D and S live on eight different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it, number 2 and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 8. L lives exactly one floor above K and exactly one floor below G. Only K lives between H and L, whereas H lives exactly one floor above J. Only D lives between S and J. F lives on the 8th floor, while S lives on the 1st floor.

On which floor does K live?
solution:
**Given: **

 
• L, K, J, H, G, F, D and S live on eight different floors of the same building. 
 
• The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it, number 2 and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 8

**Solution step by steps: **

(1.) L lives exactly one floor above K and exactly one floor below G..Thus floor block look like-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/261a123d7939ed9aa07d3df6547ebce7a2c07c9a2239e9044bad4a4fc0e8dd1d.png] 

(2.) Only K lives between H and L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53a71c2934bab1eb39035358ce63f0d25eb378f053f1080314e846481a8b84ea.png] 

(3 ) H lives exactly one floor above J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b127b415362784447466bff7277a592bce430046917ec8a461df89156999dc7b.png] 

(4.) Only D lives between S and J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a05e63f6dfa6cb89f3e47edaa103ba61a1290f8e990dd96017e21850c479c82b.png] 

(5.) F lives on the 8th floor, while S lives on the 1st floor.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8dfb9c31a98c0ca29b0d481d982fa8fc9768511d538b7b9d73cd0ed2e7f02bf.png] 

(6.) now, clear that one which lives on which floor of building as like-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0328924dabb0f0778ab26009b0da10a9bde4e4f9f8d948bd3890ec17e3a4244b.png] 

Thus,** K lives on the 5th floor.**

Hence, the correct answer is** Option (1).**
